name: The Administration
purpose: A multi-platform political simulation game in which the player is President of the United States among 50 real countries, built on a pure deterministic TypeScript engine with an Expo client for web, iOS and Android.
primaryOutcome: Close ship cycle A — live corpus — then get a first native build onto iOS and Android, with the Grail as the single self-auditing specification a fresh session can act from.
constraints: The design system in packages/ui/src/tokens is the only palette; no ad-hoc colors, spacing, radii or type.
Never git add -A and never git stash in this repo: parallel agents share one working tree.
Committed dist/ must match what src compiles to; never run typecheck before build when committing dist.
packages/engine stays pure and deterministic: no I/O, no UI, no network, enforced by the dependency-direction lint.
